lines.en: Who trampled my ash bed flat?

lines.zh: 我一振翅，草全往一边倒。
lines.en: One beat and the grass all bends.
Before sunset I must return to tend the nest fire.
Why does this cliff always block the wind?
The wind is here; the path is there.
These meadows — I know them well.

lines.zh: 两百五十点血，全化成风。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty health, all turned to wind.
There seems to be a thermal ahead.
Stay close; do not drop into the turbulence.
Do not step on the ashen shadow I cast.
Ground drops away; I glide downwind.
Do not hurry me; I walk with the wind.
I grow back out of the wind.
How far must I fly today?
Two steps through ash warms me.
The steadiest circling is mine.

lines.zh: 刚才想到哪了？风一吹就忘。
lines.en: Where was I? The wind blew it away.

lines.zh: 在热风里发呆，需要天赋。
lines.en: Dozing in a thermal takes talent.
I am waiting for the wind to turn.
Shh — I am counting sparks.

lines.zh: 我一拍翅，整片草都倒向一边。
lines.en: One wingbeat flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 我一扇翅，风就改了方向。
lines.en: One wingbeat turns the wind.
Time to fly? Wait for the wind.
Did I forget to feed the fire?
I am thinking of my first burning.
Living on the wind suits me.
The shade under the cliff is cool.
Today is good for dozing in ash.

lines.zh: 风带着我，不用自己扑翅。
lines.en: The wind carries me — I don't need to flap.

lines.zh: 我在风里悬着，不必扇翅。
lines.en: I hang in the wind and needn't flap.
The cloud passed and I still haven't moved.

lines.zh: 悬在风里也是一种本事。
lines.en: Hovering in the wind is a skill too.

lines.zh: 我扇起风，把你的味道卷过来。
lines.en: I beat my wings and sweep your scent over.

lines.zh: 看什么，我巢里没余烬了。
lines.en: What are you looking at? My nest has no embers left.
Your hands are empty, and the wind is dying.
Halt. Whose household are you from?
The smoke on you is fresh.

lines.zh: 你是猎风的，还是看火的？
lines.en: Are you a wind-hunter or a fire-watcher?
My ash has settled on your hat brim.
Is that firewood or a blade in your hand?
We meet again, wind-chaser.

lines.zh: 两百五十点生命，也没能留住我。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty health couldn't keep me.

lines.zh: 风一到，我的羽毛就散开。
lines.en: When the wind comes, my feathers fan out.

lines.zh: 我认得你踩过风的脚步。
lines.en: I know the steps you left on the wind.

lines.zh: 我的翅被风撕开一道口子。
lines.en: The wind tore a gap in my wing.
A wisp of white smoke rises from the broken quill.
Half my fire is out. The wind remains.
Ash settles in the wound and itches.

lines.zh: 羽毛断了几根，风还认得我。
lines.en: A few feathers snapped; the wind still knows me.

lines.zh: 我的羽翼一震就是一阵风。
lines.en: One beat of my wings, one gust.
Who hit me? My feathers are a mess.
The wind in my cry has scattered.

lines.zh: 我的风停了，翅膀也沉了。
lines.en: My wind has died and my wings feel heavy.

lines.zh: 火熄了一半，别再来一下。
lines.en: Half my fire is out; do not strike again.
Is that charcoal? It smells warm.
May I peck once more?
The wind's smell arrives before the grass.
I cannot look away from that flame.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的尾羽就散开。
lines.en: One gust and my tail feathers spread.
Do not stop; add another handful of wood.
The charcoal you brought last time burned brighter.

lines.zh: 为这口余烬，我能飞一圈。
lines.en: For that ember, I would fly a lap.
You even know the right heat.

lines.zh: 风把我托起来，我张开喙。
lines.en: The wind lifts me and I open my beak.
That ember — let me peck it once.
Walk slower; I follow the smoke.
That smoke makes my wings go slack.
Wind lifts me; I needn't flap.
Whoever feeds the fire is a friend.

lines.zh: 这一口草，我等了一阵风。
lines.en: I waited for a gust for this mouthful of grass.
This is not a fight, is it?
Mind the fire behind my wings!

lines.zh: 二百五十点，倒一次还有一次。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty, and one fall leaves another.
The wind is mine. Do not take it.
Next time walk around my wind.
Ow — the root of my wing.
Do not crowd; the air can jam too.
You have knocked my wind into disorder.

lines.zh: 你撞得我羽毛里冒火星。
lines.en: You knocked sparks out of my feathers.

lines.zh: 我的风把你推开了一格。
lines.en: My wind pushed you back a block.
Come with me; the wind is steady there.
I roll over in the wind.

lines.zh: 我先倒下，风会送我回来。
lines.en: If I fall, the wind brings me back.
Your feathers smell of sunlight.
Until the fire dies, I keep watch over you.
Do not fear; my fire will not burn you.
We ride the same current.
Wing to wing, warming at the same fire.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就落在你肩上。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 风里飞久了，也想落下来。
lines.en: After long flight, I want to land beside you.
One is not enough; the nest still leaks wind.

lines.zh: 这味道，像被雨浇过的炭。
lines.en: Smells like charcoal doused by rain.

lines.zh: 风里卷来的东西，都掉我这。
lines.en: Whatever the wind carries lands at my feet.
I tuck this under my feathers.

lines.zh: 咦，我这翅膀还能捡东西？
lines.en: Huh, these wings can pick things up?
I dropped on the wind and took it in passing.
So bright — it throws my firelight back.

lines.zh: 这比我那根烧焦的枝好。
lines.en: Better than my charred branch.

lines.zh: 两百五十点命，靠风养着。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty points, fed by wind.
Who dropped this? It lines my nest.

lines.zh: 你踩进我盘旋的圈里了。
lines.en: You stepped inside my circling ring.
One breath in, then I ride the wind.
Target: the one picking up my feathers.

lines.zh: 风里的一根羽毛，就是我。
lines.en: A feather in the wind. That is me.

lines.zh: 那阵逆风里有你的味道。
lines.en: Your scent rides that headwind.
You dare touch my ash nest?

lines.zh: 风一转向，我就知道你来了。
lines.en: The wind shifted and I knew you'd come.
The wind points at you: it is you.
One spread and the wind rises.

lines.zh: 我死了也会从风里回来。
lines.en: Even dead, I return out of the wind.
The wind has sealed the valley mouth.
The grass you tread bends toward me.
I only want an explanation.
Circling upwind will not help.
You hear the wingbeats, don't you?
This gust came along with me.

lines.zh: 停一步，让我看看你的气。
lines.en: Stop a step and let me see your aura.
The wind has carried me three circles.
Wait — my wing tip still burns.
The wind holds me up. I need not flap.
Do not blame me; you moved first.
I fold my wings and the wind stops.
Catch this wingbeat!
Wings serve better than beak.
You stepped on my ashes.
These sparks are a warning.
One peck, then I ride the wind back.
One charge, trailing sparks.
This is my only move, and it is enough.
Do not dodge; this wingbeat cannot be dodged.
I remember the last gust.

lines.zh: 我落地时带起的风，还没散。
lines.en: The wind from my landing has not settled.

lines.zh: 这具身子，是刚长出来的。
lines.en: This body has only just grown.
My cry pushes clouds aside.
Is there any charcoal here?
I'm Wind Phoenix. Nice to meet you.
Hm — my feathers are still gray.
The wind lifts me out of the ash.
Last fire — do you remember me?
The wind carries me down slowly.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我烧得比我该烧的旺。
lines.en: Stay back — I burn hotter than I should.

lines.zh: 我从风里掉下来，翅先着地。
lines.en: I drop out of the wind, wing-first.
Water soaks my feathers; my fire is going out.

lines.zh: 炸风掀翻我，灰里还剩一口气。
lines.en: The blast flips me; one breath remains in the ash.
An arrow took one of my feathers.

lines.zh: 这药水味压住了我的火。
lines.en: This potion reek smothers my fire.
My fire is dying; hunger leaves me cold.
Lightning crawls along my feathers and scorches them.

lines.zh: 空里什么都没有，我想回去吃草。
lines.en: Nothing in the void — I want to go graze.
